vocabulary.definition: scientists who study past human societies and cultures by analyzing artifacts and other physical remains
vocabulary.example: Archaeologists unearthed ancient pottery at the excavation site.

vocabulary.definition: equipment or items related to a particular activity or hobby
vocabulary.example: He gathered all his camping paraphernalia before the trip.

vocabulary.definition: relating to or denoting sweat glands that regulate body temperature by releasing a watery secretion
vocabulary.example: Eccrine glands help cool the body during physical exertion.

vocabulary.definition: an oily secretion of the sebaceous glands that helps to lubricate the skin and hair
vocabulary.example: Too much sebum production can lead to oily skin.

vocabulary.definition: a compound consisting of a nucleoside linked to a phosphate group, forming the basic structural unit of nucleic acids such as DNA
vocabulary.example: The genetic mutation affected the nucleotide sequence in the DNA.

vocabulary.definition: something that blocks or hinders progress or action
vocabulary.example: Clearing the road of fallen trees removed the obstructions for traffic.
